question: By which mantra should the six-limb rite and the arghya be accomplished?
premises: A six-limb rite must be performed.
The arghya must also be prepared.
The Bālā mantra is the means.
inference: Having performed the six-limb rite with Bālā, one should also accomplish the arghya with it.
plain_english: Having performed the six-limb rite with the Bālā mantra, one should also prepare the arghya with it.
